title.en: Ducati pulls its engine valves shut instead of trusting a spring 😳 #shorts
title.id: Katup mesin Ducati ditarik sampai nutup, bukan cuma pakai per 😳 #shorts

description.en: Ducati's Desmodromic valvetrain closes each valve with a second cam lobe and a closing rocker, so the valve follows a steep cam profile at high revs. The trade-off: valve clearances are checked and set by hand.
description.id: Sistem Desmodromic Ducati menutup tiap katup pakai tonjolan noken as kedua dan pelatuk penutup, jadi katup tetap ngikutin profil noken as yang curam di putaran tinggi. Kekurangannya: celah katup dicek dan disetel manual.

scenes.en: Most engines trust a *spring* to close their valves. *Ducati* doesn't.
scenes.id: Kebanyakan mesin ngandelin *per* buat nutup katup. *Ducati* nggak.

scenes.en: In a normal engine, a cam pushes the valve *open*, and a spring snaps it *shut* again.
scenes.id: Di mesin biasa, noken as dorong katup *terbuka*, lalu per balikin katupnya *nutup*.

scenes.en: At high revs, with big valves, a spring can't follow the cam's *steep closing* curve fast enough.
scenes.id: Di putaran tinggi dengan katup besar, per nggak sanggup ngikutin lekuk noken as yang *nutupnya curam*.

scenes.en: So Ducati adds a second lobe and a *closing rocker*. It grabs the valve and pulls it *shut*.
scenes.id: Jadi Ducati nambah tonjolan kedua dan *pelatuk penutup*. Katupnya ditarik sampai *nutup*.

scenes.en: Opening and closing are both *forced* by the cam. Ducati calls it *Desmodromic*.
scenes.id: Buka dan tutup sama-sama *dipaksa* noken as. Ducati namain ini *Desmodromic*.

scenes.en: The catch: the *valve clearances* have to be checked and adjusted by hand.
scenes.id: Kekurangannya: *celah katup* harus dicek dan disetel manual.

scenes.en: Send this to someone who *rides a Ducati*.
scenes.id: Kirim ini ke temanmu yang *naik Ducati*.
